errata.notes: There should not be an "else" because if PIE->dq_count_ >= DQ_THRESHOLD, this measurement is over: avg_dq_time is calculated and in_measurement is set to FALSE; otherwise dq_count has been increased before this "if" and now we wait for next packet. Resetting dq_count and measurement_start is not necessary because they will be set again when a new measurement begins.
